name: moonbag-server
description: MOONBAG backend: tracks locked supply and distributes pump.fun creator rewards to lockers every 2 minutes

scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:unlock && npm run test:fuzz
scripts.test:fuzz: DB_PATH=test-fuzz.db tsx src/test-fuzz.ts; s=$?; rm -f test-fuzz.db*; exit $s
scripts.test:engine: DB_PATH=test-suite.db tsx src/test-suite.ts; s=$?; rm -f test-suite.db*; exit $s
scripts.test:unlock: DB_PATH=test-unlock.db tsx src/test-unlock.ts; s=$?; rm -f test-unlock.db*; exit $s
